# Description

## Type of change

- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (typos, rewrites, clarifications)
- [ ] 🆕 New Content (new page, new tutorial, new blog post)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (broken links, image fix, styling fix)
- [ ] ⚙️ Configuration change (docusaurus.config.js, sidebar.js, workflows)

## Checklist: Docusaurus Specifics

### General
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code/text.
- [ ] I have run `npm run start` and verified the page renders correctly.
- [ ] **Crucial:** I have run `npm run build` locally to catch broken links (the build passed).

### Content & Markdown
- [ ] Frontmatter is correct (unique `id`, `slug`, `title`, `description`).
- [ ] All images are in the correct folder (`static/img`) and referenced correctly.
- [ ] Images have `alt` text for accessibility.
- [ ] No hardcoded external links for internal pages (used relative paths like `../docs/intro.md` or absolute paths like `/docs/intro`).

### If this is a Blog Post
- [ ] I have added the `` marker.
- [ ] I have added/verified the author in `blog/authors.yml`.
- [ ] The `authors` field in frontmatter matches the key in `authors.yml`.

### Technical
- [ ] New pages are added to `sidebars.js` (if autogenerated sidebar is not used).
- [ ] Spell check passed (no red squigglies in VS Code or ran `cspell`).
